title: The API call failed. Now what?

cases.label: 400 Bad Request
cases.good: Show which field is invalid and stop

cases.label: 401 Unauthorized
cases.good: Refresh the token once, then retry

cases.label: 404 Not Found
cases.good: Say it was deleted and offer a way back

cases.label: 409 Conflict
cases.good: Show both versions and let the user choose

cases.label: 500 Server Error
cases.good: Retry with backoff and show a friendly error

cases.label: Timeout
cases.good: Check status with an idempotency key first
